name: Nilim Kumar

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nilim Kumar writes poetry and prose in Assamese, with work that has reached readers in several languages. His selected poems appear in English as I'm Your Poet, translated by Dibyajyoti Sarma and published by Red River. His poems often begin with familiar gestures or objects and let them open into an unexpected, sometimes unsettling imaginative space.

The poems published here bring that movement into questions of intimacy and coexistence. A meal shared by two ageing lovers approaches mortality; a beautiful curve becomes an invitation and a danger. In the Afruza poems, dates offered during Ramadan and a temple imagined beside a mosque within one heart turn everyday hospitality into a language of fellowship across religious divisions.
